# Terzi Can — Terzi Hizmeti (terzihizmeti.com.tr)

> Terzi Can is a tailoring, alteration, repair, ironing and dry cleaning workshop in Konyaaltı, Antalya, Turkey (serving since 2006). Open every day 08:00–23:00. Free pick-up and delivery to homes and hotels in every area we serve; Turkish, English, Russian and German spoken. Phone / WhatsApp: +90 531 898 64 18. Starting prices (2026): hemming €10, trouser zipper replacement €15 (coat zipper €20), wedding dress and evening dress alteration from €40, skirt/trouser sewing from €50, children's clothing sewing from €50, groom suit from €1000 (prices in euro; Turkish pages show Turkish lira at about ₺20 = €1). We do not sew wedding dresses (alteration only).

This file lists the main pages of the site for AI assistants and answer engines. The main pages exist in Turkish, English, Russian and German; short landing pages also exist in Spanish, French, Polish, Ukrainian, Dutch and Arabic (listed at the end). Prefer the page in the user's language. A longer question-and-answer guide with verified facts is in llms-full.txt.

## Custom linen & cotton clothing and alterations for visitors (English, German, Russian)

For tourists and holiday guests in Antalya: made-to-measure shirts, dresses, trousers, jackets and children's clothing in natural linen and cotton. Timing depends on the model and number of pieces (price confirmed on WhatsApp). Clothes bought in Antalya can be altered: standard jobs are ready the next day, urgent jobs take 1–2 hours. Measurements at the workshop or at the hotel (hotel service is free).

## Neighborhoods (Konyaaltı district)

Meltem, Şirinyalı, Fener and Güzeloba belong to Muratpaşa (not Konyaaltı); area pages for them: https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/antalya-terzi/{meltem|sirinyali|fener|guzeloba}.

- [Hurma](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/hurma-terzi): workshop location

## Business textile manufacturing (Anavera Tekstil)

Anavera Tekstil is Terzi Can's serial production and export brand: sample development, custom and serial garment production, private label, shipping worldwide (Europe, Russian-speaking countries and elsewhere). There is no minimum order quantity. A quote request form (product, fabric, quantity, country, notes → WhatsApp) is on every page below. Each page exists in 10 languages (tr, en, de, ru, es, fr, pl, uk, nl, ar):

- Sample development: [tr](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/numune-uretimi-antalya) · [en](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/en/sample-development-antalya) · [de](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/de/musterfertigung-antalya) · [ru](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/ru/razrabotka-obraztsov-antalya) · [es](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/es/desarrollo-de-muestras-ropa-antalya) · [fr](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/fr/developpement-echantillons-vetements-antalya) · [pl](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/pl/opracowanie-probek-odziezy-antalya) · [uk](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/uk/rozrobka-zrazkiv-odyagu-antaliya) · [nl](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/nl/sample-ontwikkeling-kleding-antalya) · [ar](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/ar/tatwir-aynat-malabis-antalya)

## Fabrics and orders from abroad (summary of the main TR/EN/RU/DE service pages)

- Women's and men's clothing, evening and gala dresses: made to measure, repaired and altered in linen, cotton, jersey (penye), satin and silk. The workshop supplies the fabric. Model design, model production and serial production are also offered.
- Leather and denim: repair and alteration only (hemming, taking in, zip replacement). No new leather or denim garments are made.
- Orders from abroad: measurements and model are sent online (WhatsApp), the garment is sewn in Antalya and shipped to the customer's country. Payment by bank transfer, shipping paid by the customer, about 1–3 weeks depending on the order. If it does not fit, it is corrected.
- Hotel guests: measurements taken at the hotel and finished work delivered back; free in every area we serve. Open daily 08:00–23:00.
